purpose: Teach: 言い換えれ/気がつき/いっさい/ズバリ/いつしか/まいる/解る/はなはだ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、難しい言葉を言い換えれば翔くんも分かるわね
lines.en: Sho, if Grandpa explains things with simpler words, you'll understand them better, won't you.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact observation. Patient tone, no condescension. Slight upward lilt on the final word, inviting agreement rather than asserting. Settled and assured.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの優しさに気がつきましたよ
lines.en: Mom, I just noticed how kind Grandpa really is.
lines.style: Quiet realization dawning. Small voice, but steady and clear. No performance—just a genuine discovery being shared. Gentle wonder underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは、いっさい愚痴を仰らない方ね
lines.en: Sho, your dad is the kind of person who never complains, you know.
lines.style: Soft reflection, almost thinking out loud. Nostalgic warmth. Slight pause before the observation, as if placing it carefully. Steady, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに「ズバリ言うぞ」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa told me, "I'm going to tell you the truth straight."
lines.style: Eager to share. Slight brightness lifting the delivery. Soft quotation marks around Grandpa's words—mimicking his directness but with childlike reverence, not mockery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、いつしかお父さんに似て大きくなったわね
lines.en: Sho, you've grown to be like your dad without even realizing it.
lines.style: Tender recognition. Slow, deliberate pace. Voice softening with affection and perhaps gentle sadness—pride mixed with the passage of time. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのご機嫌を伺いに、まいるよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to check on Grandpa and see how he's doing.
lines.style: Resolved, polite. Formal register—mimicking language he's learned, slightly over-prepared. Small voice carrying real intention. No hurry, but quiet purpose.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは難しい本も解る方ね
lines.en: Sho, your dad is someone who understands even the most difficult books.
lines.style: Reflective admiration. Matter-of-fact but warm—no bragging, just stating a quiet truth. Steady pace. Slight pride in the observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、はなはだ恐縮ですって、お祖父ちゃんが仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa was saying, "I'm truly sorry for causing trouble."
lines.style: Repeating Grandpa's formal words with child-like formality. Slightly hushed, as if quoting something important. Gentle awe for the phrase itself. Small, reverent delivery.
